name: SN Gold v5
built_on: SN Gold v4 (SN_GOLD_V4.json, tag sn-gold-v4) and v3 (tag sn-gold-v3); both stay frozen and verifiable

changes_from_v4.SN56: entries: N11's signals plus the signals of its sister book R0.85 (stand-aside line at 0.85 instead of 0.9) that N11 itself did not take
changes_from_v4.SN61: scale-in when the index has moved 1 x 1-minute ATR in the trade's favour (instead of the option +10%)
changes_from_v4.SN62: the scale-in buys as many lots as the wallet can carry (pyramid to full), only if the whole position's stop still fits the day's loss room

unchanged_from_v4: N11 exits; winners >= +25% at N11's exit kept with a 3-ATR index trail to 15:10
ITM depth by money per lot
lots floor(W/15k), halved on low-volatility days
grow from Rs 15k +50% per wallet of net profit, stop after step 3
20% day loss limit (a gap can fill a stop slightly beyond it)
Zerodha charges + Rs 205 per lot per trade

owner_levers.step_trigger: after 50% of the wallet in profit (g_trig 0.5) gives more with the same worst day at cap 3
owner_levers.size_cap: stop after 3 (worst day ~-10k from Rs 15k) or 5 (~-23k)

harness: docs/research/fno/sn-gold/gold_v5.py (frozen copy of the SN51 lab; sha256 in verify_gold_v5.py)
